description: This file defines the `JsonResponse` class, which extends the base `Response` class to provide a specialized HTTP response for JSON-encoded data. It handles encoding data into JSON, setting appropriate headers, and managing response payloads and encoding options.

classes.name: JsonResponse
classes.description: A response class specialized for JSON data, providing methods for encoding data as JSON, setting encoding options, and preparing the response body with JSON content.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new JSON response, encoding provided data into JSON and setting appropriate headers and response body.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns the current payload data that will be serialized into JSON.

methods.name: withPayload
methods.description: Returns a new instance of JsonResponse with updated payload data.

methods.name: getEncodingOptions
methods.description: Retrieves the current JSON encoding options.

methods.name: withEncodingOptions
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated JSON encoding options.

methods.name: createBodyFromJson
methods.description: Creates a Stream body from a JSON string.

methods.name: jsonEncode
methods.description: Encodes data into JSON, throwing an exception if encoding fails.

methods.name: setPayload
methods.description: Sets the payload, cloning objects if necessary.

methods.name: updateBodyFor
methods.description: Generates a new response instance with updated JSON-encoded body based on given payload and encoding options.
